BWA.note: Capacity-building for leadership and staff and an e-learning system are named, but not as digital-skills training for civil servants.

facts.fact: The EU, Expertise France and HAUS Finland project, ongoing 2024-2027 with Botswana's Digital and Innovation Hub, supports and expands digital innovation programmes to enhance digital skills, in particular for women and youth entrepreneurs.
facts.system: EU Support to digital transformation in Botswana
